edge_explainer.market_believes: Silver at -48% from January's peak is the washed-out buy.
edge_explainer.we_believe: It's mid-slope of a deflating bubble until the tape proves otherwise: the physical squeeze is measurably over, the spec crowd is apathetic-long rather than capitulated-short, and $63 still needs the departed crowd to come back to be fair.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The discipline to wait for the three numbers that actually mark silver bottoms — and frozen calls that will grade this caution in public if we're wrong.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The Friday COT print, weekly; lease rates and registered stocks; the frozen 0.55 PSLV-vs-PHYS call grading the reject itself.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Any resubmission trigger firing converts this to a 1.5% bet through a lean court.
edge_explainer.edge_type: trigger-gated reject; the ledger keeps score on the court
